name: Wrist curl
summary: Forearm on the thigh, palm up, curl the weight up with the wrist and lower.
setup: Sit with the forearm on the thigh, wrist past the knee, palm up, light weight in the hand. Curl the wrist up, hold a second, lower slowly.
why: The movement is a few centimetres of hand travel. Logged by hand.
contraindications: Pain at the inside of the elbow (golfer's elbow) that grows during the set.

faults.label: Elbow lifting
faults.tip: If the elbow rises the biceps are helping; keep it pinned on the thigh.

faults.label: Weight too heavy
faults.tip: These are small muscles. Heavy weight recruits the shoulder and irritates the elbow.

faults.label: Short range
faults.tip: Let the weight roll to the fingertips at the bottom and curl all the way up.

guide.surface: A chair; forearm on the thigh.
guide.stop: Pain on the inside of the elbow.
